items.q: What do students say about eBuddha Digitech?
items.a: Learners talk about live projects, mentors who review their work and the confidence to apply for roles. Read the student stories on this page.

items.q: How many learners have trained with you?
Can I speak to a current or past student?
items.a: Yes. Ask our team when you enquire and we can connect you with learners from recent batches.

items.q: Do you have reviews from business clients?
items.a: Yes. The client reviews on this page come from businesses we have worked with, such as Nidhi X-Ray Pathology, Servoluxe Solar and Conemed Healthcare.

items.q: What results do your services aim for?
items.a: More qualified enquiries at a lower cost over time. We report from your own Search Console, GA4 and ad accounts. We do not guarantee rankings or sales.

items.q: Can I see detailed work examples?
items.a: Yes. Our case studies explain real brand campaigns with results and lessons.

items.q: Do reviews mention jobs and placements?
items.a: Many do. Our last three batches recorded a 96% placement rate, and the Alumni page shows where learners work.

items.q: Which course should I read reviews for?
items.a: Reviews cover the digital marketing, SEO, social media and performance marketing programs. Choose one from our online course or Bhopal course pages.

items.q: How can I share my own review?
items.a: Message us on WhatsApp at +91 84619 58162 and our team will help you post it.
They come from our learners and clients. You can also search for eBuddha Digitech on Google to read independent reviews.
